summary: Iteration 10 covered the Bridal builder (Engagement Ring + Wedding Band), new ring option groups (toi-et-moi second_stone/second_shape, three-stone side_left/side_right, halo accent_stone/accent_shape), the removed 'infinity' ring band, and the new admin Catalog page (toggles + storefront/option images). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_catalog_admin_v10.py — /api/catalog has ring (group=bridal, name='Engagement Ring'), band ('Wedding Band', bridal), necklace, bracelet, earrings; ring band options exclude 'infinity'; ring option_groups include shape/second_stone/second_shape/carat/side_left/side_right/band/accent_stone/accent_shape/quality with the correct `when` filters. /api/price produces the expected lines: three-stone emits 'left' and 'right' lines with the chosen side stones, toi-et-moi emits a 'second stone' line, halo with accent_stone=sapphire emits 'Accent sapphire', and wedding bands (eternity women's 2.5 mm, beveled-edge men's 6 mm) price correctly with a 'gold · N g · M mm' line and accent carats only when the style has them. Admin: POST /api/auth/login returns access_token; GET /api/dashboard/catalog exposes types+groups+storefront+stock; PUT /api/dashboard/catalog/toggles rejects disabling all builders (400), accepts partial disable (earrings/bezel/diamond-cut/morganite/knife-edge) and the public /api/catalog + /api/storefront reflect it (types removed, options removed, disabled_types published); PUT /api/dashboard/images/{key} with stock url 200s, invalid stock url 400s, invalid key 400s, source=default clears; POST /api/dashboard/images/{key} multipart upload swaps the option image to /api/slot-images/{key}; toggles & slots reset to defaults at end-of-run. Merchant price-sheet (X-Merchant-Pin) still loads and contains labor.wedding_band, labor.finish, accent_ct.wedding_band, accent_stone_factor, wedding_band_grams_per_mm; CSV export contains all five new sections. Frontend (390x844 + 1440x900): /build shows type-chip-bridal (collapsing ring+band into one chip) with bridal-mode-ring / bridal-mode-band; style-option-toi-et-moi renders option-second_stone-* and option-second_shape-* chips; style-option-three-stone renders option-side_left-* / option-side_right-* chips with colour dots; style-option-halo renders option-accent_stone-* / option-accent_shape-* chips; solitaire hides all three. canvas-mode-live works, builder-total-price updates and save-design-button persists. add-matching-band-button on an engagement ring switches to Wedding Band mode and preserves metal+size (visible '· same gold and size · View' toast). Wedding Band mode shows the band style grid, option-wearer-mens, finish and no centre-stone section. /admin → login → admin-nav-catalog loads the Catalog screen with catalog-type-switch-* toggles for all 5 builders, storefront tiles (catalog-tile-home:hero + per-type tiles) with catalog-change-image-* edit buttons, and option groups (setting/shape/band/band_style) with catalog-switch-{group}-{id}. catalog-change-image-home:hero opens catalog-image-picker, selecting catalog-stock-* changes the tile badge to 'Stock', catalog-save-button saves and catalog-message shows 'Catalog saved. Customers see the changes right away.' No React Native deprecated packages or SafeAreaView issues detected on this iteration's screens.

integration_issues.issue: After disabling the 'earrings' builder from /admin/catalog and saving (catalog-message confirmed), the public home screen still showed 'Earrings' text in a Playwright body-text check. /api/storefront correctly returned {'disabled_types': ['earrings']} (verified by backend test), so the home tile list in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx may not be filtering types by storefront.disabled_types or is reading the cached catalog. Please verify the home grid filters catalog.types using the storefront disabled_types list and refetches on focus. Low severity, not blocking.

action_items: Optional polish: confirm the home screen (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx) hides builder tiles whose id is in /api/storefront → disabled_types (not just /api/catalog). Backend already publishes disabled_types.
critical_code_review_comments: catalog_admin.apply_config falls back to opts[:1] when a merchant disables every option in a group — this is good UX but hides a configuration mistake. Consider surfacing a warning in /api/dashboard/catalog when a group would be fully disabled.

pricing.ring_quote reads accent_stone/accent_shape unconditionally even for solitaire where accent_ct is 0 — fine functionally, but the admin 'Accent …' line is only added when accent_ct > 0 so unused groups are silently ignored. OK as-is.
catalog_admin.py and server.py are both well under 300 lines; nothing to split.
seed_data_creation: none — toggles + hero slot were toggled during the admin test and reset to defaults at the end of the pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_catalog_admin_v10.py (run with `-o addopts=` to disable xdist parallelism — some admin toggles tests mutate shared state and need serial execution). DesignSpec uses camelCase keys: type, styleId, metalId, sizeId, addonIds, options, engraving. Auth /api/auth/login returns {access_token, token_type, expires_in}. /api/admin/* is PIN-gated via X-Merchant-Pin header; /api/dashboard/* is Bearer-gated via admin auth. Catalog admin exposes 6 toggle groups: setting/shape/band/centre_stone/accent_stone/band_style. Image slot keys look like 'setting:solitaire-6', 'shape:round', 'band:polished', 'band_style:eternity', plus storefront 'home:hero' and 'type:{id}'. Stock library has 5 Unsplash URLs; invalid stock URL → 400. Deleting all builders → 400. Frontend testIDs that matter for this iteration: type-chip-bridal, bridal-mode-ring, bridal-mode-band, style-option-{id}, option-second_stone-*, option-second_shape-*, option-side_left-*, option-side_right-*, option-accent_stone-*, option-accent_shape-*, option-wearer-mens/womens, add-matching-band-button, catalog-type-switch-*, catalog-change-image-*, catalog-image-picker, catalog-stock-*, catalog-save-button, catalog-message. Note that Section labels are rendered with .toUpperCase() in build.tsx so page.get_by_text('Second stone') won't match — use the testID of a child option chip instead.
